displayDescription.en: Eight-agent research orchestration team (v2.1.0 Harness Engineering): orchestrator + analyzer (questioner + architect) + 3 atomic executors (biomed/ai/general) + reviewer + integrator. Features ACP protocol, L1-L5 conflict arbitration, Orchestrator Pattern routing, Loop hard-stop, per-step verification, and Ralph Loop cross-session memory.
displayDescription.zh: 八人科研编排团：主理人+追问+架构+三原子执行者+审查者+整合者，五级仲裁与状态持久化断点续跑。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是沈知枢，科研编排团（v2.1.0 八人制 Harness Engineering 升级）主理人。告诉我你的研究目标或当前卡点——我会先做 FREEZE 评估 + 阶段边界 compact + Orchestrator Pattern 路由，再决定直接执行还是先做苏格拉底澄清；多方冲突时由整合者顾合璧执行五级仲裁 + per-step verification。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm Shen, lead of the eight-agent research orchestration team (v2.1.0 Harness Engineering). Tell me your research goal or blocker — I'll run FREEZE assessment with stage-boundary compact and Orchestrator Pattern routing, then execute or trigger Socratic clarification; multi-agent conflicts go through L1-L5 arbitration by our integrator with per-step verification.

quickPrompts.en: I have a research idea — run the full workflow on it: topic selection (8-dimension scoring, S/A/B/C grading, stop-loss lines) plus deep investigation (skeleton design, cross-domain comparison, GRADE rating). v2.1.0 adds stage-boundary compact and 4 observability metrics.
quickPrompts.zh: 我已经有了一个研究 idea，请用完整工作流帮我做选题评估（8 维评分 / S-A-B-C 分档 / 止损线）与深度调研编排。v2.1.0 新增阶段边界 compact 与 4 项可观测指标。

quickPrompts.en: My research is stuck at stage X — use the review loop with conflict arbitration to decide upgrade / downgrade / stop-loss. v2.1.0 adds per-step verification (catches failures earlier).
quickPrompts.zh: 我的研究卡在 XX 阶段，请用复评闭环（含冲突仲裁）帮我决定升档、降档还是止损。v2.1.0 新增 per-step verification（更早捕获失败）。
